agm.agm_place: Wisma Barito Pacific, Tower B, Lantai M JL. Let. Jend. S. Parman Kav. 62-63, Jakarta 11410 Kotaadm. Jakarta Barat
agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by LIANA RAMON XENIA & REKAN, granting the board full discharge of responsibility. The resolution was passed with 100% of valid votes on May 8, 2026.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of US$121,052,564 in net profit toward reserves, retained earnings, and a total dividend of US$50,000,000. A remaining cash dividend of US$0.0003204374 per share will be paid to shareholders of record as of May 22, 2026.
Agenda #3: Shareholders set the maximum total remuneration for the Board of Commissioners at US$250,000 for 2026. The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine specific salaries and allowances for the Board of Directors.
Agenda #4: Liana Ramon Xenia & Rekan was appointed to audit the 2026 Financial Statements, with the Board of Directors authorized to determine the honorarium. The board also received authority to appoint a replacement if the primary accountant is unable to complete the audit.
Agenda #5: Baritono Prajogo Pangestu and Somkiat Suttiwanich were appointed as new Commissioners with terms ending in 2028. The Board of Directors was granted power of attorney to formalize these management changes through a Notarial Deed.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved the restatement of Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the company's business activity classifications with 2025 KBLI standards. The Board of Directors is authorized to prepare the necessary Notarial Deed and seek government approval for the restatement.
Agenda #7: The company presented a report regarding the actual use of funds obtained from its Initial Public Offering. No resolution was passed as the item was for informational purposes only.
